headline: All of your Week 5 games are final. Nobody on your roster plays in Bills at Rams on Monday night, so the lineup is locked and no swaps are possible.
alerts: 1:20 PM Monday: Every Sunday game is final, including Falcons vs. Ravens. No verdicts changed.
5:15 PM Monday: Bills at Rams is the only game left. Rams favored by 3.5 with a 54.5 total. You have no Bills or Rams players, so nothing to do.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so check the app for your final score and the opponent's Monday night players.
11:50 AM: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston and S Derwin James. Ladd McConkey is active. Keep Keaton Mitchell in the FLEX, he could see a few extra targets.
11:55 AM: Lions and Cardinals inactives were not posted yet. Neither St. Brown nor Brissett is on the final injury report, so no change is expected. Check Sleeper before 1:25 PM.
1:05 PM: Chargers vs. Broncos locks (Mitchell). 1:25 PM: Lions at Cardinals locks (Brissett, St. Brown).
5:20 PM: Falcons vs. Ravens on Sunday night. Brian Robinson has no injury tag. Ravens Zay Flowers and Marlon Humphrey are expected to play.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so confirm in the app that Brissett, St. Brown, Mitchell and Robinson are in your starting slots.
8:31 AM: Justin Jefferson is active vs. the Saints. Jordan Addison is inactive. Keep Jefferson at WR.
8:40 AM: Terry McLaurin is active but expected to be on limited snaps. Leave him on the bench.
8:39 AM: Bears ruled out Caleb Williams again. Tyson Bagent starts, a small boost for the Packers and Matthew Golden.

8154.name: Brian Robinson
notes: Steady No. 2 back behind Bijan Robinson with goal-line work: 4 TDs over the last two games.
Falcons are 3-point favorites after the line flipped from Ravens -6, and Lamar Jackson is out, so a lead and late carries are likely.
Touchdown dependent. He catches very few passes.
No injury tag for Sunday night. Ravens expect Flowers and Humphrey to play.

9511.name: Keaton Mitchell
notes: Led the Chargers backfield in Week 4: 10 carries plus 6 targets, ahead of Omarion Hampton.
Still a three-way committee with Hampton and Kimani Vidal, and the Chargers project for only about 19 points against Denver.
Coin flip with Lloyd. Mitchell gets the slight edge on passing-game work.
Not listed as inactive. With Quentin Johnston out and both top Denver corners out, the Chargers passing game gets a small bump.

11581.name: MarShawn Lloyd
notes: Lead back only because Josh Jacobs is on the exempt list, but averaging 2.7 yards per carry with no game over 10 points.
Split carries with Kaleb Johnson last week (7 to 8), though he caught 5 passes.
